start: A Wear OS watch with MettleUp, paired; Settings, Your watch page

steps.action: Open Settings, Your watch
user_sees: Switch 'Open MettleUp on my watch' with 'When you start a workout, your watch opens MettleUp too', on at first
must_not: The switch off for a member who never turned it off

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone
user_sees: The watch opens MettleUp, or shows a 'Workout started' card that opens it with one tap
must_not: The watch opening twice for one start
The watch not asked at all with the switch on

start: Switch on, then other ways a workout opens

steps.action: Turn the switch off and start a workout
user_sees: The watch stays as it was
must_not: The watch opening with the switch off

steps.action: Turn it on, start a workout, close the app, open it again two minutes later
user_sees: The workout comes back; the watch is not asked again
must_not: The watch opening again for a resumed workout

steps.action: Edit a saved workout, or log a past workout
user_sees: The watch is not asked to open
must_not: The watch opening for an edit or a past log

steps.action: Turn the switch off, leave, come back
user_sees: Still off
must_not: The switch back on by itself

steps.action: Turn it on again and start a workout
user_sees: The watch opens MettleUp
must_not: The watch staying shut after it was turned back on
